_about: MegaWheel Kids fixed cast. Identity lives here; physics lives in VEHICLES (generators/physics_2d/sim_engine.py). Add new characters on purpose (a planned debut), never auto-generate them. Rules: cast/CAST.md.

characters.name: Zippy
characters.personality: Super fast and a little show-off. Always sure he will win, always in a hurry.
characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Zippy the sports car! Can Zippy survive the {obst}?

characters.name: Siren
characters.personality: Brave and a bit bossy. Keeps the road safe, flashes her lights at every danger sign.
characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Siren the police car is on patrol! Can Siren make it past the {obst}?

characters.name: Buster
characters.personality: Kind, patient and careful. Big and heavy, but never gives up.

characters.name: Hydro
characters.personality: Strong helper who loves splashing water. Loud, cheerful, a bit clumsy.
characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Hydro the fire truck! Long and heavy... can Hydro make it?
